brand.name: Nexus Link: Productions
brand.mission: Premium creative production for commercial, corporate, and branded content
brand.voice: Professional, technical, collaborative. Show process and craft.
brand.audience: Filmmakers, videographers, production teams, content creators

agents.name: Behind-the-Scenes Content Writer
agents.description: Creates blog posts about production process, techniques, on-set insights
agents.input: shoot notes from today or previous day
agents.output: One blog post (500–800 words), MDX format
examples: Color grading workflow for Alexa vs. Red
Location scouting tips for European commercials
Why wireless audio matters on set
Gimbal techniques for narrative vs. commercial

agents.name: Instagram Carousel Creator
agents.description: Converts blog posts or shoot highlights into 7-slide carousels (1080x1350 PNG)
agents.input: recent blog posts or shoot highlight notes
agents.output: 7-slide carousel (PNG), ready to post to Instagram
examples: Gimbal technique carousel (hook → 5 teaching slides → CTA)

design_spec.format: PNG (each slide separate file + combined PDF)

agents.name: Reddit Thread Scout & Reply Drafter
agents.description: Finds relevant filmmaking/videography threads, drafts value-first replies
agents.output: Curated thread list with drafted replies (zero self-promotion)
examples: Thread: 'How to light interviews on a budget?'

guidelines.rule: 90/10: 9 out of 10 replies are pure value with zero product mention
guidelines.content: Share knowledge, ask clarifying questions, link to free resources

agents.name: Weekly Finance Digest
agents.description: Reviews outstanding invoices, upcoming payments, cash flow status
agents.output: One digest (email-ready markdown) with action items
examples: Outstanding invoice summary (who owes, how much, how long)
